Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Security: Terrorist bases and assembly points struck in Boulkessi and Kadiana by pro-government forces
Mali.summary: Bamako, 14 November (AMAP) The Armed Forces General Staff provided an update on the recent operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners. These actions, which form part of Operation Dougoukoloko, aim to secure the national territory, according to a statement issued on Friday. .

Mali.title: Why the Malian army is targeting the communication channels of armed groups in the north
Mali.summary: The Malian army claims to have intercepted a consignment of 2,000 portable radios north of Timbuktu, in northern Mali, on Monday 9 November 2026. The report from the General Staff of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), made public on Wednesday, 11 November, states that the shipment also included a pick-up truck and eight motorbikes, and that this equipment was intended to supply armed groups in the region.

Mali.title: Mali: JNIM attacks against civilians in the Ségou and Mopti regions
Mali.summary: On Friday, 13 November 2026, the Malian army claimed airstrikes against "terrorist" targets in Kadiana, Bougouni Region, and in Boulkessi, Douentza Region. . The day before, jihadists from JNIM, linked to al-Qaeda, had claimed responsibility for shelling the military camp in Léré, in the Timbuktu region, and for two attacks on military positions in the Mopti region.

Mali.title: GOONGA TAN: Illegal gold mining:...
Mali.summary: GOONGA TAN: Illegal gold mining: Is Guinea groping in the dark? On 2 November 2026, Guinean President Mamadi Doumbouya announced, by decree read out on national television, the dismissal of twenty-two local government officials in post in the Siguiri region. .

Mali.title: JUSTICE IN MALI: Six years after the bloody robbery in Kalabancoura, the death penalty is handed down to the murderers of Dr Abdramane Kodio
Mali.summary: The judicial epilogue to a case that had sent shivers down the spines of the people of Mali's capital has just been delivered. On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the Bamako Assize Court delivered a harsh verdict, sentencing the three main defendants to death for the murder of pharmacist Abdramane Kodio, who was shot dead in his pharmacy in July 2020. .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso issues arrest warrants for around 20 people, including journalists
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso on Friday issued arrest warrants and extradition requests for around 20 people including exiled journalists, activists, an ex-minister, and former military officers. They are accused of several terrorism-related charges including complicity in terrorist activities, financing of terrorism, and the “glorification of terrorism”. Alleged acts of defamation, undermining the morale of the National Armed Forces and contempt of public authority, are also reportedly mentioned.
